newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel at new standoff.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel at new standoff.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was weaker again on Friday in line with futures but buyers and sellers were at a stand off, traders said.

One potential seller said prices were close to $121 fob NWE for 0.5 percent sulphur material, but others said that given the large quantities available in February and early March, buyers would be some $7 a tonne beneath these levels.
